replay.entry: Drive these public items on o1: mixdog-ai/src/service/error_text.rs:174 present_error_text; mixdog-ai/src/service/error_text.rs:346 safe_error_details; mixdog-ai/src/retry/classify.rs:142 kind_of (classifies Facts (status, code, scope) into an ErrorKind; `pub mod retry`, `pub mod classify`; the nearest to providerErrorKind, whose input is an error object).

inputs.clock: the current time (new Date(), Date.now) is the fixed instant 1800000000000 = 2027-01-15T08:00:00.000Z for the whole run; a replay must give the code under test this instant
inputs.locale: not read: no Intl or toLocale* on these paths; toDateString is locale-independent
inputs.timeZone: UTC: the reset wording ("09:00", "1/15 09:00") is the local time of resetAt, and the month/day prefix appears when its local day differs from the current local day; a replay must run with this zone

missingOnO1: providerErrorKind over an error object and the DETERMINISTIC_KINDS list: kind_of takes Facts, no constant list of deterministic kinds

normalised.secretShapedInput: sk-DUMMY- marker in the redaction case (the fixture secret scan refuses the original shape)
normalised.socketErrors: Node's errno text is the core's typed TransportFault: an E probe with code ECONNRESET is fault_from_io(ConnectionReset, after connect); EPIPE, ETIMEDOUT and ECONNREFUSED are an I/O or connect fault carrying the OS error of that name (taken from the platform's own error numbers); the T probe (undici `TypeError: fetch failed`, which hides the errno) is fault_from_io(ConnectionRefused, connecting) with no OS error (mixdog-ai/src/transport/fault.rs); kind_of reads the fault, never the code text
normalised.timeZone: recorded with TZ=UTC (the reset wording is local time); resetAt = the fixed clock + 1 h
